search.title: Kenyon Martin
search.snippet: Kenyon Lee Martin Sr. (born December 30, 1977) is an American former professional basketball player who played 15 seasons in the National Basketball Association

search.title: Kenyon Martin Jr.
search.snippet: Kenyon Lee "KJ" Martin Jr. (born January 6, 2001) is an American professional basketball player for the Ningbo Rockets of the Chinese Basketball Association
